body: V1-2008 (PR #1283) routed AGENTS.md, AGENT-ROUTES, docs/README, README and host skills to docs/CAPABILITIES.md, but the speckit command texts are not routed and the OpenSpec skill metadata version stays 0.1.0 after its content changed. Pi is not routed because its version tuple is pinned.
title: Route spec-kit command texts and fix OpenSpec skill metadata version to the capability catalog
